# Square routes

Every route square's surface serves -- vendor-facing only. The `/__unit/*` control plane is the same for every vendor; see [Control plane](control-plane.md).

| Method | Path | Operation | Capability | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/oauth2/authorize` | Authorize | oauth | Authorization page. Redirects back with an authorization code. |
| POST | `/oauth2/token` | ObtainToken | oauth | Exchange an authorization code, or refresh an access token. |
| POST | `/oauth2/revoke` | RevokeToken | oauth | Revoke an access token, or every token held for a merchant. |
| POST | `/oauth2/token/status` | RetrieveTokenStatus | oauth | Scopes and expiry for the bearer token presented. |
| POST | `/v2/orders` | CreateOrder | order-lifecycle | Create an order. Idempotent on idempotency_key. |
| POST | `/v2/locations/{location_id}/orders` | CreateOrderAtLocation | order-lifecycle | CreateOrder on its pre-2019 path; the location comes from the URL. |
| POST | `/v2/orders/search` | SearchOrders | order-lifecycle | Filtered, sorted, cursor-paginated order search. |
| POST | `/v2/orders/batch-retrieve` | BatchRetrieveOrders | order-lifecycle | Retrieve up to 100 orders by id, ignoring ids that do not exist. |
| GET | `/v2/orders/{order_id}` | RetrieveOrder | order-lifecycle | Retrieve one order, reflecting every committed mutation. |
| PUT | `/v2/orders/{order_id}` | UpdateOrder | order-lifecycle | Sparse update under optimistic concurrency. |
| POST | `/v2/orders/{order_id}/pay` | PayOrder | order-lifecycle | Pay an open order and move it to COMPLETED. |
| GET | `/v2/merchants` | ListMerchants | merchant-directory | Every merchant the caller can reach -- one, in this unit. |
| GET | `/v2/merchants/{merchant_id}` | RetrieveMerchant | merchant-directory | One merchant by id, or `me` for the caller's own. |
| GET | `/v2/locations` | ListLocations | merchant-directory | Every location for the seeded merchant. |
| GET | `/v2/catalog/list` | ListCatalog | merchant-directory | Catalog objects, filtered by type and cursor-paginated. |
| GET | `/v2/catalog/object/{object_id}` | RetrieveCatalogObject | merchant-directory | One catalog object; an ITEM carries its variations. |
| POST | `/v2/catalog/search` | SearchCatalogObjects | merchant-directory | Catalog objects by type, by name prefix or exactly, or changed since a time. |
| POST | `/v2/catalog/object` | UpsertCatalogObject | merchant-directory | Create or update one ITEM (with its variations) or one ITEM_VARIATION. |
| POST | `/v2/inventory/changes/batch-create` | BatchChangeInventory | inventory | Apply physical counts and adjustments to IN_STOCK counts. |
| POST | `/v2/inventory/counts/batch-retrieve` | BatchRetrieveInventoryCounts | inventory | Counts filtered by object, location, state or change time. |
| GET | `/v2/inventory/{catalog_object_id}` | RetrieveInventoryCount | inventory | One variation's counts across locations. |
| POST | `/v2/payments` | CreatePayment | payments | Take an EXTERNAL payment, optionally against an order; autocomplete by default. |
| GET | `/v2/payments/{payment_id}` | GetPayment | payments | Retrieve one payment. |
| POST | `/v2/payments/{payment_id}/complete` | CompletePayment | payments | Capture an APPROVED payment and tender its order. |
| POST | `/v2/payments/{payment_id}/cancel` | CancelPayment | payments | Void an APPROVED payment. |
| GET | `/v2/loyalty/programs/{program_id}` | RetrieveLoyaltyProgram | loyalty | The seller's loyalty program, by id or as `main`. |
| POST | `/v2/loyalty/accounts/search` | SearchLoyaltyAccounts | loyalty | Accounts by phone-number mapping or by customer id. |
| POST | `/v2/loyalty/accounts` | CreateLoyaltyAccount | loyalty | Enrol a buyer by E.164 phone number. |
| POST | `/v2/loyalty/accounts/{account_id}/accumulate` | AccumulateLoyaltyPoints | loyalty | Add points for an order (computed from the accrual rule) or a stated amount. |
| GET | `/v2/webhooks/event-types` | ListWebhookEventTypes | webhooks | Event types this unit can emit. |
| POST | `/v2/webhooks/subscriptions` | CreateWebhookSubscription | webhooks | Register a subscriber and receive its signature key. |
| GET | `/v2/webhooks/subscriptions` | ListWebhookSubscriptions | webhooks | List subscribers. |
| GET | `/v2/webhooks/subscriptions/{subscription_id}` | RetrieveWebhookSubscription | webhooks | Retrieve one subscriber. |
| DELETE | `/v2/webhooks/subscriptions/{subscription_id}` | DeleteWebhookSubscription | webhooks | Remove a subscriber. |
| POST | `/v2/webhooks/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/test` | TestWebhookSubscription | webhooks | Send a signed test event and report the subscriber status code. |
